label: Received esse adds nothing to the essence-only derivation of finitude, checked (inference)
rule: Derive the explanandum on each account and factor the reception account through the essence-only one
meaning: Premise-free comparison at matching scope: finitude in perfection of whatever is not its own being follows on the essence-only account and on the reception account, both from the same nature premise; the reception premises imply the essence-only premise on non-own beings.
